  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  May 14, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room “A” 1st
Floor. On May 14, 2026, at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Angel – Leon Martell, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services Department

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley, Deputy City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Christine Rivera asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Christine Rivera reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on April 30, 2026

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Reonna Johnson, on behalf of the City of Inglewood, to host a Creative Reset a Mental
  health Event at 1623 Centinela Ave, Private Property, on Saturday, May 16, 2026, from
  10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m and Sunday, May 17, 2026 from, 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO: Approval for a two (2) day event within
  private property parking lot. Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean-up, and
  all applicable mitigation measures. This event shall be contained to the private property
  indicated on this application. Applicant shall hire a minimum of four (4) professional-
  licensed security guards, who must wear reflective vests for the safety of attendees.
  Security personnel shall wear reflective vests; use Security Guard vehicles to block the
  entryway; and be present at all times in case the vehicle needs to be moved for EMT.
  Security guards must be identifiable to attendees. NO use of public sidewalks, streets, or
  alleys, and NO drone usage; IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra patrol-high
  visibility will be provided as time permits. Maintain the site at all times, ensuring the site is

  cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00427047)

Item #2:  Ernest Kevin Supertran, on behalf of First Chapter Development, Inc / Ernest Supertran,
  to host a Temporary Costco Special Event to sell duplicate Auto Keys, at 3560 W Century
  Blvd; Private Property; from Tuesday, June 02, 2026, to Sunday, June 28, 2026, from 9:00
  a.m. to 8:30 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO: Approval for a multi-day
  day event within Costco parking lot. Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean
  up, and all applicable mitigation measures; APPROVED: Applicant shall submit any state
  licensing if applicable. Adhere to all local, state, and federal laws; No recommendations
  needed for Fire approval; No condition for Code Enforcement; Maintain the site at all times,
  ensuring it is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, personal protective hygiene,
  and face mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and
  CA State health department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00427126)

Item #3:  Sydney Jackson Jr. / Danny Tabor, on behalf of Fratgames LLC, to host a Community
  Softball Games Event at 3400 W Arbor Vitae St, Darby Park Baseball field ( Big Field),
  City Park, on Sunday, June 14, 2026, to Sunday, August 30, 2026, from 2:15 to 5:45 p.m.
  APPROVED Approval for a 12-time event at Darby Park. Subject to Parks and Rec
  approval for use of the park. Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event cleanup.
  Subject to all applicable IMC regulations, Applicant shall hire a minimum of two (2)
  professional, licensed security guards (or off-duty police officers who are Fraternity
  members) to ensure the safety of all attendees. Applicant shall verify approval with the
  Parks & Recreation Department for park use on all Sundays from 06/14/26 to 08/30/26.
  There shall be NO alcoholic beverages permitted at any of these events. Applicant shall
  adhere to all local, state, and federal laws. Conditions for amplified sound: Manage noise
  reading. Comply with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29. Provide a direct point of contact of the
  person in charge of sound and acoustics volume control; Maintain the site at all times,
  ensuring it is cleaned properly immediately at the end of the event. Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, personal protective hygiene,
  and face mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and
  CA State health department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00427103)

New Business License Renewal Request (s);
  Item #4: Vaughn Williams III, on behalf of House Bingo, to operate as a bingo hall at 685
  S. La Brea Ave. Approval for a bingo hall. Approved Conditionally: Applicant of the
  proposed bingo operation, provided the applicant fully complies with all applicable
  provisions of the Inglewood Municipal Code and State law. Pursuant to IMC Section 8-82.1,
  the applicant shall obtain and maintain a valid City-issued bingo permit/license prior to
  conducting, facilitating, or supplying any bingo games. All operations shall be conducted in
  strict accordance with IMC Section 8-82.2, including all City Council-approved Bingo Rules
  and Regulations and California Penal Code Section 326.5. Any violation of these provisions
  may be subject to misdemeanor enforcement under IMC Section 8-82.3. In the interest of
  public safety, the applicant shall ensure that bingo activities are conducted only at the
  approved location, during authorized days and hours, and without deviation into any
  unapproved or unlawful gaming activity. The applicant shall provide adequate, licensed
  security personnel to maintain order, ensure compliance with applicable laws, and monitor
  for any illegal gambling or disorderly conduct. All ingress and egress points shall remain
  clear and unobstructed at all times, and operations shall not interfere with pedestrian or
  vehicular access. The applicant shall also maintain a video surveillance system covering
  all areas of operation for the safety of attendees and for police investigatory purposes
  should any illegal or criminal activity occur or be suspected. The applicant, its officers and
  or employees shall make such footage immediately available upon request to any law
  enforcement/peace officer or City Code Enforcement officer. The applicant shall remain in
  compliance with all required application and annual licensing fees pursuant to IMC Sections
  8-82.4 and 8-82.5 and shall permit inspections by IPD and City Code Enforcement officials
  to ensure compliance. Failure to adhere to these conditions or any applicable laws shall
  result in enforcement action up to and including possible suspension or revocation of the
  permit and may subject the applicant to criminal prosecution. The applicant shall adhere to
  all local, state, and federal laws.Must comply with all conditions of SUP23-00023. Must
  complete the Building Safety plan check before the 1-year renewal. Subject to all applicable
  IMC regulations, Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00427080)

Item #5:  Julian Barrera Jr. on behalf of House Bingo to operate as a used car dealership at 10200
  Hawthorne Blvd. Unit # A APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license fee and taxes; An
  expired or lapsed license for more than six months will negatively impact your license
  renewal; Parking, repairs and/or maintenance on city streets, sidewalks, or alleys of any
  vehicles for sale is strictly prohibited and violators will be cited and towed at owner’s
  expense;Applicant and all employees must have a valid ID and DMV / Dealer licenses if
  applicable;Subject to inspection by any Code Enforcement Officer or Police Officer; Adhere
  to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code (IMC) rules and regulations (including noise and
  signage) Local, State and Federal Laws.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any
  future business license application requests.Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00427062)
